'''2022 MPC Top 8 Justin Miyashiro LS Legend''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Miyashiro]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Miyashiro]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker|V11-L-thegalaxymayneedalegend.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open The Galaxy May Need A Legend Mi 2.txt |Download]]
